title: Rating London gelato like a data scientist
hook: Rating London gelato like a data scientist
summary: Every "best gelato in London" list is vibes. So I'm scoring them properly.
body: Every "best gelato in London" list is vibes. So I'm scoring them properly.

The Gelato Index starts now.
Four scores, weighted: texture 30%, flavour 30%, value 20%, vibe 20%.
Same test flavour everywhere (pistachio), plus one wildcard. Scores out of 10, then weighted.
AI picks where I go next and has to argue for it. I check whether it was right.

Where should I go first? Comment your favourite London gelato spot. Top comment gets scored first.
Follow for the leaderboard.
